name: Shopify, MCP surfaces for buyer agents, developers and merchants
status: Three distinct MCP surfaces are documented or published by Shopify: checkout for buyers' agents (server-side Checkout MCP and, since 2026-09-28, Checkout WebMCP), the local developer package @shopify/dev-mcp (latest version 1.16.0, 2026-09-25), and a remote MCP for merchants at setup.shopify.com/mcp. For the merchant surface the source is Shopify's own toolkit repository; no page on shopify.dev was found for it. A fourth surface is for shoppers' agents: the command-line client @shopify/shop (npm, MIT; version 1.0.3 published 2026-10-08, 01:20 UTC, after 1.0.2 on 2026-10-07), whose repository Shopify/shop has its latest commit d1e8c7c on main (2026-10-08, 01:17 UTC); neither the README, the skill file nor the transactions reference declares a beta or preview status or a list of supported countries (not found, 2026-10-13).
relevance: Buyers' agents: the documentation says "Use Checkout WebMCP when your agent runs in the buyer's browser. If your agent can run on a server, then use Checkout MCP", and that Checkout WebMCP "implements the UCP checkout capability (dev.ucp.shopping.checkout)"; see ucp and browsers-webmcp. Developers: @shopify/dev-mcp is a local npm package (npm registry, read 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-13, version 1.16.0 published 2026-09-25). Merchants: Shopify-AI-Toolkit v2.1.0 (2026-10-01) states "The Cursor plugin, which Grok Bot also installs from the Cursor Marketplace, now connects to Shopify's remote MCP at `setup.shopify.com/mcp`"; the file .cursor-plugin/mcp.json at that tag declares an http server with that URL and an auth block with a client id, and v2.1.1 (2026-10-08) changes the plugin description to "Create and manage your store with Shopify". The toolkit release v2.0.1 says "Regenerated agent skills from @shopify/shopify-dev-tools 1.17.1"; the package @shopify/shopify-dev-tools returns E404 on the npm registry (2026-10-08 and 2026-10-13). Since v2.0.0 the toolkit publishes UCP as a separate skill: the CHANGELOG entry for 2.0.0 reads "UCP ships separately as `ucp`", and the folder skills/ucp at the tag v2.1.1 (commit 26d0623, 2026-10-08, 00:34 UTC) holds a SKILL.md named ucp whose description begins "Use when the user wants to use the UCP CLI to find, compare, buy, or track products from online merchants" and which requires the binary ucp (read 2026-10-13). Shopper's agents: the README of Shopify/shop (commit d1e8c7c, read 2026-10-13) says the command-line interface (CLI) "lets agents search millions of stores, build carts, check out and pay with the shopper's Shop account, and track orders" and is a client of Shop's MCP server at mcp.shop.com. It says: "Some stores have no agent checkout API (UCP); the agent has to enter a payment credential into the site's checkout form in a browser." For that case the shopper approves a "spend request" on Shop and the agent receives a one-time credential up to the approved limit; the skill file says "Prefer Shop/UCP checkout when available". The reference skills/shop/references/transactions.md says of the agent's report on the purchase "This records your report, not payment confirmation.", of a credential state "`consumed` without an `instrument` does not establish credential delivery or payment.", and of cancelling the request "this does not cancel/refund the purchase or revoke an issued credential." The core of the CLI is a compiled binary (lib/shop.wasm, about 1.9 MB), so its logic is not readable as source; the repository holds nine commits, all of 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08. No call was made to any MCP or OAuth endpoint; only documentation, repositories and listings were read.
participation: The author of this map opened issue #62 of Shopify/Shopify-AI-Toolkit on 2026-09-26 (release notes and a source link for @shopify/dev-mcp, and two telemetry questions), still without comments on 2026-10-13; see Disclosure.

evidence.read: Toolkit releases v2.0.0 to v2.1.1 and the two plugin files, shopify.dev pages on Checkout WebMCP, the developer changelog of 2026-09-28 and the MCP developer page, npm registry metadata, issue #62, read 2026-10-08; on 2026-10-13: the list of toolkit releases (latest v2.1.1, 2026-10-08), the CHANGELOG and the folder skills/ucp at the tag v2.1.1, the npm registry entries of @shopify/dev-mcp (1.16.0) and @shopify/shopify-dev-tools (E404), and issue #62 (open, no comments).
evidence.not_read: The shopify.dev pages on Checkout WebMCP, the developer changelog of 2026-09-28 and the MCP developer page were not re-read on 2026-10-13 (last read 2026-10-08). help.shopify.com, any merchant-facing page on shopify.com, the telemetry code of the toolkit, the X post of the Shopify product manager on Checkout WebMCP; the compiled binary lib/shop.wasm and the .mjs files of Shop CLI, the server mcp.shop.com (no call made), the plugin files of Shop CLI.
evidence.not_found: Not found, 2026-10-08: setup.shopify.com in the shopify.dev pages read (the MCP developer page and the changelog index); a page of Shopify describing the merchant MCP. Not found in the README, SKILL.md and transactions.md of Shopify/shop at d1e8c7c (2026-10-13): beta, preview, experimental, a list of supported countries, and a confirmation sent to the shopper on a durable medium.
